Description[/b]
This mod changes the tree texture in Stardew Valley. It replaces the original tree appearance with a custom design while keeping all in-game functionality unchanged. This is purely a visual retexture and has no impact on gameplay.

[b]Installation Guide[/b]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install AT mode.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the files.[/*]
[*]Add this folder into the Stardew Valley > Mods.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Replaces the default tree sprite with a custom texture.[/*]
[*]No changes to gameplay mechanics or balance.[/*]
[*]Lightweight visual retexture mod.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI (latest version recommended)[/*]
[*]Alternative Textures[/*]
[/list]
